headline: Quinn finishes sustained right‑side build-up from a corner to restore Northgate lead
explanation: The goal (event 725) came immediately after a period of structured possession and right‑side delivery: Osei’s corner (719) and a sequence of successful passes into the final third (716, 718, 721, 724) moved play into the home box area. Quinn had been positioned high and involved in nearby duels (foul, event 722) which placed them on the end of the delivery where they converted a 0.24 xG chance (725).
tactical_pattern: Right‑side overloads leading to set‑piece delivery into the box and late runs/physical presence from the striker to finish from a high‑value area.
